package knowledgeidentity

import (
	"context"
	"testing"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
)

type bindingRepositoryStub struct {
	got []domain.CourseLessonSourceBinding
}

func (s *bindingRepositoryStub) ResolveCourseLessonBindings(_ repository.Context, refs []domain.CourseLessonSourceBinding) ([]domain.ResolvedCourseLessonBinding, error) {
	s.got = append([]domain.CourseLessonSourceBinding(nil), refs...)
	return []domain.ResolvedCourseLessonBinding{{
		CourseLessonSourceBinding: refs[0],
		CourseID:                  "course-id",
		LessonID:                  "lesson-id",
	}}, nil
}

func TestResolveCourseLessonBindingsNormalizesAndRejectsDuplicatePairs(t *testing.T) {
	repo := &bindingRepositoryStub{}
	resolver := ResolveCourseLessonBindings{Bindings: repo}
	resolved, err := resolver.Handle(context.Background(), []domain.CourseLessonSourceBinding{{
		CourseSourceKey: " course.catalog ",
		LessonSourceKey: " course.catalog.lesson ",
	}})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("resolve binding: %v", err)
	}
	if len(resolved) != 1 || resolved[0].CourseID != "course-id" || resolved[0].LessonID != "lesson-id" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected resolution: %#v", resolved)
	}
	if repo.got[0].CourseSourceKey != "course.catalog" || repo.got[0].LessonSourceKey != "course.catalog.lesson" {
		t.Fatalf("source keys were not normalized: %#v", repo.got)
	}
	_, err = resolver.Handle(context.Background(), []domain.CourseLessonSourceBinding{
		{CourseSourceKey: "course.catalog", LessonSourceKey: "course.catalog.lesson"},
		{CourseSourceKey: "course.catalog", LessonSourceKey: "course.catalog.lesson"},
	})
	if err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected duplicate source binding rejection")
	}
}
